lines.line: With zero same-clip controls, stock TRIBE v2's language readout followed the story each healthy listener group heard, more than other stories from the same dataset, on 29 of 33 story families not individually scored before this test (English and French; LPP sections counted once per language; 2 public datasets, 4 blocks, 1210 listeners, 2.7-55.6 minutes = 106-2222 TRs per story; wrong-label check 6 of 33).
